Subject convention: `events.{domain}.{tenantId}.{eventType}` (system events: `events.system.{eventType}`).\n227\t2. Shared `NatsSubjectBuilder` utility in `libs/backend-common` constructs subjects from domain, tenantId, event type.\n228\t3. Subscribers use wildcards: `events.auth.*.UserCreated` (all tenants) or `events.auth.{tenant}.>` (single tenant).\n229\t4. Backward compatibility: dual-subscribe old + new patterns during migration with deprecation warning.\n230\t\n231\t---\n232\t\n233\t### Finding H-18: GDPR Cross-Service Erasure Orchestrator\n234\t\n235\t**Complexity:** HIGH\n236\t**Dependencies:** M-15 (tenant-scoped subjects improve event routing)\n237\t**Estimated time:** 8 hours\n238\t\n239\t#### Current State\n240\t\n241\tMessaging-service has comprehensive GDPR erasure. Auth-service has consent management + partial user lifecycle deletion. No GDPR erasure for: farm, hr, billing, sensor, hydroponics services.\n242\t\n243\t#### Files to Modify\n244\t\n245\t1. `libs/event-contracts/src/gdpr/gdpr-events.ts` (NEW) -- Define GDPR event contracts: `GdprErasureRequested`, `GdprErasureCompleted`, `GdprErasureFailed`\n246\t2. `libs/backend-common/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.interface.ts` (NEW) -- Define `GdprErasureHandler` interface that each service implements\n247\t3. `apps/admin-api-service/src/security/services/compliance.service.ts` -- Add erasure orchestration endpoint that emits `GdprErasureRequested` event\n248\t4. `apps/auth-service/src/modules/gdpr/services/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Handle user data anonymization in auth schema\n249\t5. `apps/farm-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize farm data (ownership records, notes, comments)\n250\t6. `apps/hr-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize HR records (employee PII)\n251\t7. `apps/billing-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize billing data (retain financial records with anonymized PII per legal retention requirements)\n252\t8. `apps/sensor-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize operator assignments on devices\n253\t9. `apps/hydroponics-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize operator references\n254\t\n255\t#### Implementation Approach\n256\t\n257\t1. **Saga pattern**: Orchestrator emits `GdprErasureRequested` with `{ userId, tenantId, requestedBy, legalBasis }`.\n258\t2. Each service listens, replaces PII with `REDACTED-{hash(userId)}`, retains non-PII, emits `GdprErasureCompleted` or `GdprErasureFailed`.\n259\t3. Orchestrator tracks per-service completion; marks complete only when ALL services report success.\n260\t4. Legal hold check before erasure (extend messaging-service pattern to orchestrator).\n261\t5. Each action audit-logged via `AuditLogModule` with legal basis and timestamp.\n262\t\n263\t---\n264\t\n265\t### Finding M-10: Per-Service PostgreSQL Connection Strings\n266\t\n267\t**Complexity:** MEDIUM\n268\t**Dependencies:** None (init-scripts already create per-service roles)\n269\t**Estimated time:** 3 hours\n270\t\n271\t#### Current State\n272\t\n273\tPer-service PG roles exist in `00-init-schemas.sh` with schema-specific grants, but compose files still use shared `aquaculture` superuser in `DATABASE_USER`.\n274\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"47dbba44-7be2-455c-84e4-4387cd2bb7d7","uuid":"03332763-68c8-4d62-90ac-7d413ce89dad","timestamp":"2026-09-21T02:40:46.523Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-36a7df700ca6/docs/plans/2026-04-01-security-remediation-remaining.md","content":"\n1. Backward compatibility: dual-subscribe old + new patterns during migration with deprecation warning.\n\n---\n\n### Finding H-18: GDPR Cross-Service Erasure Orchestrator\n\n**Complexity:** HIGH\n**Dependencies:** M-15 (tenant-scoped subjects improve event routing)\n**Estimated time:** 8 hours\n\n#### Current State\n\nMessaging-service has comprehensive GDPR erasure. Auth-service has consent management + partial user lifecycle deletion. No GDPR erasure for: farm, hr, billing, sensor, hydroponics services.\n\n#### Files to Modify\n\n1. `libs/event-contracts/src/gdpr/gdpr-events.ts` (NEW) -- Define GDPR event contracts: `GdprErasureRequested`, `GdprErasureCompleted`, `GdprErasureFailed`\n2. `libs/backend-common/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.interface.ts` (NEW) -- Define `GdprErasureHandler` interface that each service implements\n3. `apps/admin-api-service/src/security/services/compliance.service.ts` -- Add erasure orchestration endpoint that emits `GdprErasureRequested` event\n4. `apps/auth-service/src/modules/gdpr/services/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Handle user data anonymization in auth schema\n5. `apps/farm-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize farm data (ownership records, notes, comments)\n6. `apps/hr-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize HR records (employee PII)\n7. `apps/billing-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize billing data (retain financial records with anonymized PII per legal retention requirements)\n8. `apps/sensor-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize operator assignments on devices\n9. `apps/hydroponics-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize operator references\n\n#### Implementation Approach\n\n1. **Saga pattern**: Orchestrator emits `GdprErasureRequested` with `{ userId, tenantId, requestedBy, legalBasis }`.\n2. Each service listens, replaces PII with `REDACTED-{hash(userId)}`, retains non-PII, emits `GdprErasureCompleted` or `GdprErasureFailed`.\n3. Orchestrator tracks per-service completion; marks complete only when ALL services report success.\n4. Legal hold check before erasure (extend messaging-service pattern to orchestrator).\n5. Each action audit-logged via `AuditLogModule` with legal basis and timestamp.\n\n---\n\n### Finding M-10: Per-Service PostgreSQL Connection Strings\n\n**Complexity:** MEDIUM\n**Dependencies:** None (init-scripts already create per-service roles)\n**Estimated time:** 3 hours\n\n#### Current State\n\nPer-service PG roles exist in `00-init-schemas.sh` with schema-specific grants, but compose files still use shared `aquaculture` superuser in `DATABASE_USER`.\n","numLines":50,"startLine":225,"totalLines":474}}}

Writing raw JSONL to output_path means\n    # kernel submit-result reads runtime telemetry instead of the envelope,\n    # which fails:\n    #   response_schema: missing required fields:\n    #     ['$schema', 'request_id', 'claim_id', 'agent_id', 'role',\n    #      'status', 'satisfaction_matrix']\n    #\n    # HOW: parse JSONL, extract the final message, find the embedded\n    # envelope JSON, INJECT mandatory identity fields ($schema,\n    # request_id, claim_id, agent_id, role, status) from the known\n    # ci_executor context (these aren't the agent's job — the agent\n    # only knows its plan content), synthesize a satisfaction_matrix\n    # from must_satisfy with verdict=satisfied when the agent omitted\n    # it, then write the corrected envelope to output_path.\n    #\n    # Tier hierarchy: Tier-2 (Make it automatic) — the envelope shape\n    # is now produced correctly by default; agents don't have to know\n    # internal kernel identity fields.\n    if completed.stdout:\n        envelope = _build_envelope_from_claude_output(\n            raw_stdout=completed.stdout,\n            request_id=request_id,\n            claim_id=claim_id or \"\",\n            agent_id=agent_id or \"\",\n            role=role,\n            subagent_type=subagent_type,\n            must_satisfy=must_satisfy or [],\n            # ARIA-MEDIUM-171 — the rung that answered, not the frontmatter.\n            dispatch_model=completed.model or agent_profile.model,\n            usage=completed.usage,\n        )\n        envelope[\"details\"][\"agent_contract_hash\"] = agent_contract.contract_hash\n        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        _write_sanitized_envelope(output_path, envelope)\n        resolved_transcript_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        resolved_transcript_path.write_text(completed.stdout, encoding=\"utf-8\")","numLines":40,"startLine":2290,"totalLines":5532}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GveajXG1b9oW6hhWkvRJWJ","type":"tool_result","content":"2584:def _build_envelope_from_claude_output(\n2585-    *,\n2586-    raw_stdout: str,\n2587-    request_id: str,\n2588-    claim_id: str,\n2589-    agent_id: str,\n2590-    role: str,\n2591-    subagent_type: str,\n2592-    must_satisfy: list[dict[str, Any]],\n2593-    dispatch_model: str | None = None,\n2594-    usage: dict[str, Any] | None = None,\n2595-    confidence_source: str = \"self_reported\",\n2596-) -> dict[str, Any]:\n2597-    \"\"\"Convert ``claude -p stream-json`` JSONL into a kernel-valid envelope.\n2598-\n2599-    ``confidence_source`` is the ROUTE's word on where a judge's confidence\n2600-    came from (typed-judgment plan, ARIA-HIGH-167): every CLI and chat\n2601-    completion in the fleet reports the model's own number\n2602-    (``self_reported``); a typed decision transport that returns\n2603-    probabilities natively stamps ``provider_reported``.
